headline: Deploy {arm:brisk-s.few}. It is the only configuration that clears latency, overall accuracy, and every cell floor.
lede: {arm:brisk-s.few} delivers {measure.balanced_accuracy.brisk-s.few.mean} Balanced accuracy at {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.few.p95} p95 latency. Lowering the cell floor below {criteria.cell_floor.nano-xs.few.complex.news.value} would allow the cheaper {arm:nano-xs.few}.

slots.text: Adopt {arm:brisk-s.few}: it satisfies all gates with {criteria.overall.brisk-s.few.value} Balanced accuracy, clears all nine target cells, and costs {measure.cost_per_1m.brisk-s.few.mean} per million turns.
{arm:nano-xs.few} misses the cell floor on complex news turns; {arm:atlas-m.rubric} exceeds the latency budget; and {arm:brisk-s.zero} fails overall accuracy.
The tightest margin is {weakest.arm}: {weakest.value} against {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.threshold}, a clearance of {weakest.margin} points. Calibration on complex news remains unmeasured.
Test targeted few-shot examples for complex news on {arm:nano-xs.few} to evaluate whether its {criteria.cell_floor.nano-xs.few.complex.news.value} accuracy can clear the floor.

method.text: Full factorial evaluation testing {count.arms|words} configurations across {count.cells|words} complexity and domain target matrix cells.
Evaluated across {scoreboard.brisk-s.few.cases} stratified dialogue turns sampled from production corpus distributions.
A turn passes only when predicted labels match ground truth for both complexity level and domain category.
Requires Balanced accuracy at or above {criteria.overall.threshold}, cell accuracy at or above {criteria.cell_floor.threshold}, and p95 latency at or below {criteria.p95.threshold}.
Calculated from observed token usage multiplied by standard vendor list prices per million turns.
